name: Twilio Verify
description: Send verification codes through the Twilio Verify service.

fields.name: verifyServiceSid
fields.description: The Twilio Verify service SID used to send verification codes.

fields.name: from
fields.description: The sender shown as the origin of the verification messages, where supported.

fields.name: authToken
fields.description: The Twilio auth token. Set either this or an API key and secret pair.

fields.name: apiKey
fields.description: The Twilio API key. Set together with an API secret instead of an auth token.

fields.name: apiSecret
fields.description: The Twilio API secret. Set together with an API key instead of an auth token.
